## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the gold text on playing cards box and move it outward.

Task description: The target is the black card box with gold text and patterns right of the table center. Pick up and move the whole box. In this episode, 'outward' means to the right in the image, away from the table centerline.

Success criteria: Move the card box to the outer right table region, far from the centerline and sufficiently outside the central operating area. A slight shift near its original position is insufficient. Both grippers must be open at completion.

## Execution tips

- The card box is thin. Consider approaching from above with fingers outside its long edges and gripping the middle sidewalls. Open slightly wider than the box and confirm the pads cover the walls without fingertips pressing the table before closing, reducing empty grasps or pushing the box away.
- The table area to the box's right on the robot side is relatively open. Use it to move outward, leaving clearance for the brown wallet behind, blue-and-white packaging, and protruding gripper to avoid sweeping box corners or fingers into nearby items.
- Before releasing or adjusting the grasp, let the box rest on the table so it is supported, reducing the risk of dropping, turning it over, or sliding it back toward the center.
